79K likes, 871 comments - natgeo on October 20, 2026: "Don't let its stubby arms fool you—Koleken inakayali was an ambush predator from the abelisaurid family that once thrived in the Southern Hemisphere. Named by National Geographic Explorer @poldiego and colleagues, Koleken inakayali's tiny forelimbs continue to puzzle experts. 

Learn more about Koleken inakayali at the link in bio.".
